'''Bluefinland''' (Japanese: '''ツナタウン''' ''Tuna Town'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in [[Johto]]. It is a northern port town on [[Blue Point Isle]] that runs a ferry to [[Yellow Rock Isle]]. 

{{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} wanted to get to Bluefinland in ''[[EP212|Takin' it on the Chinchou]]''. However, they accidentally ended up in another town called [[Blue Lagoon]]. After Ash and his friends saved a group of {{p|Chinchou}} from {{TRT}}, the group now traveled to Bluefinland and took the ferry to Yellow Rock Isle. When the boat left, {{an|Misty}} spotted a {{p|Corsola}} on the docks of Bluefinland, much to her delight.

==Name origin==
Bluefinland is probably a reference to {{wp|Finland}}, a country in Northern Europe. It may also come from {{wp|Bluefin}}, which is a species of tuna. Furthermore, it could be a pun on {{wp|Newfoundland}}, an island that makes up the Canadian province {{wp|Newfoundland and Labrador}}.
